adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb line 22: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`. This takes a client-provided limit parameter and converts it to an integer with no upper bound validation. A malicious client could pass an extremely large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) to force the server to load and serialize a massive number of user records, potentially causing resource exhaustion. This is a real security/DoS vulnerability introduced by this code.
